context.retroactive_note: Implementations already committed to main. Design artefact produced after the fact for pipeline continuity and audit record.

task.description: WF-03 Step 2 (retroactive design) for ISS-0813/ISS-0812/ISS-0820/ISS-0823. Document the route prefix audit, the dead-admin-prefix guard pattern, the removed/fixed identity.ts functions, the regression coverage decision, the search-params correction decision, and the user-list truncation decision. Design artefacts only — no implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: ISS-0813 AC1: mechanical check fails CI when a web/src client path literal names a /api/v1 route the backend does not mount
ISS-0813 AC2: check covers all of web/src/api/, not just identity.ts
ISS-0813 AC3: cheaper interim guard asserts /api/v1/admin/ appears only for /api/v1/admin/services
ISS-0813 AC4: guard wired into the web/ check pipeline
ISS-0812 AC1: every usersApi and rolesApi function either calls a URL a real backend route serves, is removed, or is explicitly recorded as unimplemented
ISS-0812 AC2: audit covers the whole file
ISS-0812 AC3: regression coverage asserts method+path for each corrected or retained call
ISS-0820 AC1: definitionsApi.search sends only parameters handle_search/1 actually reads, or backend extended with choice recorded
ISS-0820 AC2: live caller at useDefinitions.ts:94 updated to match
ISS-0820 AC3: test asserts exact query parameters the search call emits
ISS-0823 AC1: Add-member dropdown reflects every user OR states plainly list is incomplete
ISS-0823 AC2: if drain used it is bounded and cap is explicit
ISS-0823 AC3: availableUsers subtraction at GroupsPage.tsx:103-110 is correct when either input is truncated
ISS-0823 AC4: test covers a tenant with more than 200 users

regression_coverage.removed_not_tested_rationale: Removed functions have no backend route at any prefix; a test asserting a dead path gives false coverage and is a maintenance liability

search_params.decision: Fix frontend — remove limit/offset, add cursor/page_size
search_params.backend_not_extended_rationale: Offset pagination is not implemented in this codebase; cursor pagination is the project-wide standard; adding limit/offset would be a WF-01 feature

truncation_warning.drain_rejected_reason: No safe upper bound; large tenants would drain many requests and hold large datasets in memory
truncation_warning.return_type_corrected: PagedResponse<User> → CursorPage<User> (matches Letflow.Api.Pagination.Page struct: items, next_cursor, count)
truncation_warning.available_users_subtraction_correct: Set-membership check; correct for items present; warning discloses truncation to operator

summary.open_questions: None — all decisions stated with rationale; full path-literal audit against __authz_routes__/0 is a deferred WF-01 item, not an unstated assumption
